subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt this narrower run/harness/context bucket policy, the broader all-duration policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or pause until exported metric defaults are settled?
rationale: Both branches use the supported OTel API, but they change existing exported metric aggregation differently and neither has real behavior proof yet, so automation cannot safely choose the product default.

options.title: Choose one policy after proof
options.body: Select the intended bucket scope and range, then require the selected PR to show redacted real OTel collector/export output before merge.

options.title: Accept this narrow policy
options.body: Proceed with this PR only if maintainers want to limit the default change to run, harness, and context-token histograms despite the broader related proposal.

options.title: Pause for diagnostics defaults
options.body: Keep both PRs paused until diagnostics owners decide whether OTel should mirror Prometheus duration buckets or use agent-specific ranges.

recommendation.title: Choose one policy after proof
recommendation.body: Select the intended bucket scope and range, then require the selected PR to show redacted real OTel collector/export output before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent diagnostics-otel migration and metric-surface history make this the strongest available owner signal for the bucket-default choice.
